card.name: Words inside all-caps warning text
card.fires_on: Words in ALL-CAPS passages, such as boxed warnings and allergy cautions, especially short linking words (TO, HAVE, NON, LIFE) just before a hyphen or a continuing phrase.

modes.label: Linking word in caps warning
modes.description: A short capitalized word like TO or HAVE in an all-caps sentence about giving a drug or reported rates.
modes.example: IF CEFDINIR IS<< TO>> BE GIVEN TO PENICILLIN-

modes.label: Before a hyphenated compound
modes.description: A capitalized first part of a hyphenated term in a caps warning heading.

modes.label: Plural ending in caps
modes.description: The ending of a capitalized word such as PATIENTS in an all-caps sentence.
modes.example: APPROXIMATELY SIX PATIENT<<S>> PER ONE MILLION POPULATION PER YEAR

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward continuing in capital letters, with caps fragments promoted and code-like caps tokens suppressed.
card.plain: It lights up on words in all-capital warning text, such as boxed warnings and allergy cautions.
